leakage_analysis.limitation_note: Detects lexical n-gram overlap between train and test sets. Semantic rephrasing or shared boilerplate disclaimers may still occur.

dataset_provenance.dataset_name: Shahriar University Phishing & Enron Legitimate Corpus
dataset_provenance.primary_paper: Shahriar, S., Mukherjee, A., & Gnawali, O. (2022). Improving Phishing Detection Via Psychological Trait Scoring. IADIS MCCSIS 2022.
dataset_provenance.description: Curated benchmark combining genuine phishing emails collected from university security reports and legitimate enterprise emails from the Enron corpus. Strictly separates phishing from legitimate (NOT generic spam/commercial marketing).

limitations_and_ethics.calibration_note: Logistic regression sigmoid probabilities are uncalibrated and reflect linear score confidence.
known_limitations: Model relies on lexical and structural n-gram patterns in text and cannot verify actual cryptographic email signatures (SPF/DKIM/DMARC).
Novel zero-day phishing lures that use unfamiliar phrasing may evade bag-of-words classifiers (false negatives).
Legitimate emails that contain urgent business deadlines or invoice discussions may trigger false alarms (false positives).
Designed as a decision-support demonstration tool, not an autonomous email gateway.
